question: How is Śambhu portrayed in the burning of the three cities with the universe steadied on one chariot?
premises: The universe was steadied in one place
He was uplifted on a chariot
inference: Śambhu is portrayed as the chariot-borne burner of the three cities who steadied the universe
uncertainties: Internal analysis of ekasthairyaviśva admits more than one compound resolution
plain_english: He is Śambhu, burner of the three cities, who uplifted the chariot on which the universe was steadied.
